turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on capital letters and full stops?
turns.tutor:
Start each sentence with a capital letter, write I as a capital, and end with a full stop.
Right: "Today I saw a big ship."
Wrong: "today i saw a big ship" It has no capital T, a small i, and no full stop.
My example: "The zoo opens on Sunday." Capital T at the start, full stop at the end.
Now you. Rewrite correctly:
"my brother likes tea"
